'''Derek''' is a minor character in {{SA}}.

He is voiced by [[Benjamin Byron Davis]], who is best known as the voice of {{Red Dead|Dutch van der Linde}} in [[Rockstar Games]]' ''{{Red Dead|Red Dead Redemption}}'' and ''{{Red Dead|Red Dead Redemption 2}}''.

==History==
===Background===
Derek is an employee at a [[Gasso|gas station]] in [[Dillimore]], where he serves people at the till.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
Derek is seen in the mission [[Tanker Commander]], where he reluctantly gives chase (being forced to do so by another employee) to [[Carl Johnson]] and [[Catalina]] who had stolen a [[tanker]] full of petrol.

The player can choose to kill him by getting out of the tanker and shooting him or dealing enough damage to his [[Sabre|car]] during the chase and cause it to explode. If the player doesn't do this and delivers the tanker to [[Mr. Whittaker]]'s [[RS Haul|depot]], a cutscene ensues where Derek crashes the car into a gas station and blows it up. Derek manages to jump out of the car before impact and survives, as does the other employee, although both can be killed after the mission has been completed. Derek also gets scared during the chase and says things like; ''"This ain't my fight!"'', or ''"That rig will crush us!"'' all whilst the gas station owner is yelling at him to get closer so he can get a better shot.

==Character==
===Appearance===
Derek shares his character model with a refined [[Pedestrians|pedestrian]] (WMOST) who can be found all over [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]].
